nfl.oneThing: Tampa Bay beat Dallas 24–16 on Thursday Night Football for their first win of the season, and the Cowboys drop to 2–3.

wrap.summary: Week 5 was led by Tampa Bay's first win of the season over Dallas, but the week's biggest result for the table was Kansas City staying unbeaten after beating Las Vegas. Minnesota and San Francisco also stayed unbeaten, and Carolina and Atlanta made their own moves.

storylines.text: The Raiders lost 27–30 to the Chiefs in Week 4. Kirk Cousins threw for 365 yards and 2 touchdowns, but Las Vegas couldn't hold on to the lead.
The Buccaneers got their first win of the season with a third-quarter surge against Dallas, with Bucky Irving the standout runner.
Minnesota, San Francisco and Kansas City are all unbeaten after four games, and the NFC's top seeds are separating from the field.
Atlanta beat New Orleans 45–24 to move to 2–2, and the Saints fell to 1–3.

headlines.title: Buccaneers beat Cowboys on Thursday night
headlines.summary: Tampa Bay pulled away in the third quarter to beat Dallas 24–16 on Thursday Night Football. Jerry Jones called the loss "extraordinarily disappointing".
headlines.whyItMatters: The Buccaneers move to 1–4 with their first win, and the Cowboys drop to 2–3 and third in the NFC East.

headlines.title: Prescott irked by stadium worker's comment
headlines.summary: Dak Prescott took exception to a stadium worker who yelled "embarrassing" at him as he walked to the locker room after the loss. He has since addressed the comment.
headlines.whyItMatters: This is a sideline story rather than a standings one, but it adds to a tough week for Dallas.

headlines.title: Swift says fumble problems are behind him
headlines.summary: D'Andre Swift fumbled twice in Chicago's first four games. He said Thursday that the turnover problem is "over with now". He is listed as questionable with a hip issue.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Bears are 3–1 and 5th in the NFC, and ball security will matter in their next game against the Packers.

nba.oneThing: LeBron James made his 76ers debut in a preseason loss to the Nets, 114–108.

wrap.summary: Preseason week, so no standings changed. LeBron James made his 76ers debut in a loss, and the Lakers and Spurs had mixed results.

storylines.text: LeBron James made his 76ers debut in a 114–108 loss to the Nets, scoring 10 points in 18 minutes.
The Lakers beat the Kings 114–110, with Doncic and Reaves combining well.
The Spurs lost 116–123 to the Hawks in their first preseason game, with Dylan Harper starting well.

headlines.title: LeBron's 76ers debut ends in defeat
headlines.summary: LeBron James scored 10 points in 18 minutes in his first game for Philadelphia, but the 76ers lost 114–108 to the Nets. He said it is "going to take some time" for the new team-mates to gel.
headlines.whyItMatters: It's a preseason result, so the standings are still 0–0 across both conferences.

headlines.title: Doncic and Reaves show chemistry in Lakers win
headlines.summary: Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves combined well in the Lakers' 114–110 win over the Kings in a preseason game.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers are leaning on their two guards this season, and the early signs are positive.

headlines.title: Spurs start strong but lose to Hawks
headlines.summary: San Antonio lost its first preseason game 116–123 to Atlanta at home. Dylan Harper stood out in the starting lineup.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Spurs are 0–1 in the preseason, and the regular season hasn't started yet.

headlines.title: Cavs' defence under scrutiny in opening loss
headlines.summary: Cleveland lost its preseason opener 113–124 to the Celtics. The defence was the main concern in the post-game takeaways.
headlines.whyItMatters: It's an early test for the Cavaliers, but preseason results don't count towards the standings.

headlines.title: Bruce Brown keeps pushing for a Knicks roster spot
headlines.summary: Bruce Brown had another solid preseason showing in the Knicks' 109–111 loss to the Wizards.
headlines.whyItMatters: The preseason is his best chance to show he belongs on the roster.

contextCard.title: What counts in the preseason
contextCard.body: Preseason games don't count towards the standings or the playoff race. Every team's record stays at 0–0 until the regular season starts. Preseason results can show rotations and early form, but they don't change the table.
